protocol.objective: Minimize native total_training_time with full CORE strictly above 0.256525
protocol.timer: Training iterations, excluding evaluations and logging; setup/tokenizer training and later SFT are separate stages
protocol.core_formula: mean_i((accuracy_i - r_i) / (1 - r_i)); r_i = Random baseline percentage / 100
protocol.core_mean_weighting: Equal weight per task, not pooled examples
protocol.core_interpretation: Chance-level task score maps to 0, perfect to 1; CORE is not raw accuracy
protocol.integration_criteria: Principled generalization across model depths and code simplicity are considered alongside speed/quality
